data.action: 立于神殿石栏边单手扶巨剑剑柄，英气微笑
data.animaCaption: Standing along a sunlit marble temple colonnade overlooking the mountain city of Septimont, she rests one hand on her greatsword hilt with a radiant, commanding smile as sunrise gilds her red cape.
data.camera: 全身镜头，低机位英雄仰拍
data.description: 俯瞰七丘山城的白色大理石日轮神殿柱廊上，朝阳金辉洒满大地，奥古斯塔身着红金执政官战袍与黄金桂冠，单手扶剑柄霸气俯瞰。
data.lighting: 破晓烈日金辉与大理石柱廊强轮廓光
data.location: 七丘日轮神殿大理石柱廊
data.promptProse: High on the white marble colonnade of Septimont's solar temple at dawn, Augusta stands tall in her crimson-and-gold archon regalia and golden laurel crown, resting a hand upon her greatsword.
data.title: 奥古斯塔 · 七丘日轮神殿柱廊烈阳加冕
